title: unmask overload error (feature 008, schema 008.1)
description: Body of 429 (kind=rate_limited) and 503 (kind=busy) responses of GET /api/token/{mint}. Always accompanied by the HTTP header `Retry-After: <retry_after_seconds>` (delta-seconds, same integer). An overload error is never an analysis result: it carries no clusters, score or band and is never cached. Success documents (schema 004.1) and 400/500 error documents are unchanged by this feature.

mint.description: The requested path segment as received (unvalidated for rate_limited).
